title: Monodromic Perverse Sheaves on Shifted Contact Stacks
summary: Applying the BBDJS minimal model to the derived symplectification of a $-1$-shifted contact derived Artin stack and descending algebraically along the structural free $\mathbb{G}_m$-action, we construct an $\ell$-adic perverse sheaf on any oriented such stack, and use Verdier's specialization equivalence for monodromic sheaves to equip it with a tame twisted monodromy operator $θ$. We show that the local fundamental class of a Legendrian $L$ satisfies $θ\circ μ_L = (-1)^{\mathrm{vdim} L}μ_L$, so that on Legendrians of odd virtual dimension, the class vanishes due to $θ$-invariance.
